annotations.title: Get an upload link for a large file

description: A private upload link (valid 15 minutes) for sending a file of any size straight into a bucket with an HTTP PUT, for example: curl -T file.zip "<url>". Use it when the file is over 100 MB or lives on the customer's own computer or server. The result also has dashboard_upload_url: a page where the customer can drag the files into that folder without a terminal; for several or large attachments you cannot send yourself, give them that page. It replaces an existing file with the same key.

bucket.description: Bucket name (3-63 lowercase letters, digits, dots, hyphens).

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

key.description: Where the file will be saved.

region.description: Region code from storage_plans or storage_overview, e.g. fra (Frankfurt), usa (Virginia), sgp (Singapore).

service_id.description: Object Storage service id, as returned by the matching list tool.
